cobol_source.note: Original COBOL source is not part of this repository. Set 'root' (relative to repo_root or absolute) or the environment variable to enable source availability checks.

generation.note: Java generation is not authorised. It requires this flag AND an approved generation gate (G4 PASS), which cannot occur before a later step.

neo4j.note: STEP 1 does not contact Neo4j. Verification results recorded by the reverse agents are reported with attribution, never as live checks.

orchestrator.note: java_target_dir is the only place F5 may ever write Java; it is null (no target authorised) until a later step authorises generation.

approval.note: trust_store is null: no trust anchor is provisioned, so G1 cannot pass. Provision public keys only (see forward/docs/HUMAN-APPROVAL-OPERATIONS.md); private keys never belong in this repository.

bmad_governance.note: STEP 21: every governed forward run needs a verified LIVE BMad receipt for each lifecycle stage (requirements, architecture, stories, sprint, implementation, review) for its exact scope; until then it is BMAD_BLOCKED, and Java generation through the workflow also needs the stages up to sprint. Local LGA conversions stay valid historical records and are never BMad-governed.

model_verification.note: Verified against the official model page and the Structured Outputs guide on 2026-10-31 (Responses API v1/responses supported; structured_outputs listed). Re-verify before any LIVE run; the runtime never substitutes another model.

openai_verification.note: OFFLINE and network disabled by default. LIVE requires network_enabled=true, the API key in OPENAI_API_KEY and a signed source-export authorization verified against the trust store. An API key, a CLI flag, a G1 approval or an agent statement is never export authorization.
